system.description:
A disciplined heavy two-handed weapon specialist. You don't parry — you end fights.

  • Crushing Blow: Reroll 1s and 2s on the damage dice of two-handed weapons.
  • Breaker: Advantage on Strength checks to break, smash, or force objects.
